The program is now called QuickFind everywhere in the app. That covers the window title, the About text, the tray menu, the program file (now `QuickFind.exe`), the logo file, the saved-data folder name and the start-with-Windows entry. The .NET version's folder, project, files and code are renamed too, to `app\dotnet\QuickFind`. Both versions build and the check passes.

Two leftovers:
- The .NET build folder still holds an old `OmniFind.exe` that I couldn't delete, next to the new `QuickFind.exe`.
- If you had "Start with Windows" turned on under the old name, switch it off and on again to use the new name.
